description: This SPECIAL EDITION selection follows Enterprise's early encounters with Andorians, Ferengi and hostile unknown vessels as Archer's crew begins testing humanity's place among older interstellar powers.

s01e01.description: Archer's visit to a Vulcan monastery becomes a hostage crisis when suspicious Andorians claim the monks are hiding a military secret.

s01e02.description: A mysterious alien vessel repeatedly attacks Enterprise while the crew races to bring its unfinished defensive systems online.

s01e03.description: T'Pol and Archer are captured on Coridan as the fallout from P'Jem threatens both Vulcan relations and Enterprise's mission.

s01e04.description: Ferengi raiders incapacitate the crew and begin stripping Enterprise, leaving Archer, Tucker and T'Pol to turn greed against the intruders.

s01e05.description: Enterprise transports a disgraced Vulcan ambassador whose supposed misconduct conceals a political crisis and a dangerous pursuit.
